metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 1,000 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: Full corpus (23,994 pairs). No labels. MySQL source run on DuckDB; 1,071 pairs are not run (DuckDB rejects them, mostly a table name the schema spells differently and GROUP BY positions that name aggregates). Search settings were tuned on a 1,000-pair sample (every 24th pair), so the other pairs are held out from that tuning. Measured on master 7b7ba13 (harness translation #347, HAVING-only wider search #356); prover rules merged later (cast_rules.py and after) are not rerun yet. VeriEQL refutes pair 21215 without a replayable counterexample; read by hand, it is equivalent (GROUP BY 1 vs GROUP BY the key, IS NOT NULL on the primary key). 2026-10-04: 6 proofs fewer (4,793 to 4,787): the parser check refuses the pairs whose MySQL text uses `||` as OR (MySQL's default reading; sqlglot reads concatenation), found by re-running the 17 pairs it refuses on master and on this branch, not by a full rerun (docs/parser-checks.md).
held_out: Search settings tuned on every 24th pair (1,000); the other 22,994 pairs are unseen: 3,310 of the 3,586 pairs VeriEQL refutes are refuted here too (92%).
